[
  {
    "id": "TP01",
    "name": "asynchronous_reset_recovery",
    "action": "Assert rst_n low asynchronously during reset, idle, start preparation, FIFO pop, address restart, transmit hold, or receive hold, then release reset and re-enable the transaction engine.",
    "variation": "Reset source phase: idle, start preparation, FIFO pop, repeated start, transmit hold, receive hold",
    "observation": "Observe load_tx_shifter, mst_tx_en, mst_rx_en, start_en, restart_en, stop_en, state outputs, abort outputs, and mst_rx_ack_nack.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises reset initialization and recovery from active transaction phases, ensuring outputs return to inactive or idle behavior before a fresh launch."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP02",
    "name": "transaction_admission_gating",
    "action": "Enable the engine with an empty FIFO, busy bus, or flush request, then provide an idle bus, data, and no flush to admit a transaction.",
    "variation": "Admission conditions: empty/non-empty FIFO, idle/busy bus, flush asserted/deasserted",
    "observation": "Observe start_en, mstfsm_idle_state, load_tx_shifter, pop_tx_fifo_state, and transaction control outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises launch qualification and blocking conditions so transactions begin only after enable, bus availability, FIFO data, and flush clearance."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP03",
    "name": "start_and_address_transfer",
    "action": "Enable with queued data, complete the start condition, and complete the initial addressed-byte transfer with acknowledge in read and write directions.",
    "variation": "Direction command: read/write; address completion: waiting/acknowledged",
    "observation": "Observe start_en, load_tx_shifter, pop_tx_fifo_state, mst_tx_en, gen_7bit_addr_state, tx_byte_state, and abort outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises the normal start and addressed-byte sequence, establishing the selected direction before subsequent data handling."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP04",
    "name": "captured_transfer_direction",
    "action": "Complete the addressed byte, change tfr_cmd direction before data handling, and observe whether data processing follows the originally captured direction.",
    "variation": "Captured direction and later command direction: all read/write combinations",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_en, mst_rx_en, tx_byte_state, gen_7bit_addr_state, and mstfsm_b2b_rxshift.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises direction capture at address completion and prevents later command changes from altering the active data operation."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP05",
    "name": "address_acknowledge_failure",
    "action": "During the addressed-byte transfer, deassert ack_det with optional stop selection, complete shifting, and then complete the generated stop condition.",
    "variation": "Stop command: absent/present; direction: read/write",
    "observation": "Observe abrt_7b_addr_noack, stop_en, gen_stop_state, mstfsm_idle_state, and transaction control outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises addressed-byte NACK handling and stop termination, including the failure indication and recovery toward idle."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP06",
    "name": "transmit_data_continuation",
    "action": "Transmit acknowledged data bytes, vary FIFO availability, and continue with another byte when data remains or hold the bus when the FIFO becomes empty.",
    "variation": "FIFO condition: empty/non-empty; acknowledge: asserted",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_en, tx_byte_state, load_tx_shifter, pop_tx_fifo_state, mstfsm_emptyfifo_hold_en, and stop_en.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises acknowledged write continuation and empty-FIFO holding, covering byte progression and deferred completion."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP07",
    "name": "transmit_stop_and_nack",
    "action": "Complete a transmitted byte with either a requested stop or missing acknowledge, then provide stop completion with queued or empty FIFO status.",
    "variation": "Stop cause: requested/NACK; queued status: queued/empty",
    "observation": "Observe abrt_txdata_noack, stop_en, gen_stop_state, mstfsm_idle_state, and subsequent start control outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises write termination for normal stop and data NACK, distinguishing abort indication from successful stop routing and queued restart."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP08",
    "name": "receive_data_continuation",
    "action": "Process received bytes with completion indications, continuing when FIFO data remains and completing without a hold request when no data remains.",
    "variation": "FIFO condition: empty/non-empty; receive completion: asserted",
    "observation": "Observe mst_rx_en, mst_rx_shift_check_hold, mstfsm_emptyfifo_hold_en, pop_tx_fifo_state, and mstfsm_b2b_rxshift.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises normal read-byte progression and completion, including FIFO-driven continuation and no-hold termination."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP09",
    "name": "receive_bus_hold",
    "action": "Request receive holding while the FIFO is empty, release the hold by supplying FIFO data, and complete the held receive with restart or stop selection.",
    "variation": "Hold command: restart/stop; FIFO: empty/non-empty; completion: pending/done",
    "observation": "Observe mst_rx_en, mst_tx_en, mstfsm_emptyfifo_hold_en, mstfsm_b2b_rxshift, restart_en, stop_en, and mst_rx_ack_nack.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises receive-oriented bus holding, stored completion history, and routing to continued receive, repeated start, or stop."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP10",
    "name": "command_acknowledge_outputs",
    "action": "Sweep command stop, restart, FIFO-empty, and preloaded-restart combinations during reset and active receive-hold contexts.",
    "variation": "All combinations of {preloaded_restart_bit, FIFO-empty, restart, stop}: 16 patterns",
    "observation": "Observe mst_rx_ack_nack, mstfsm_emptyfifo_hold_en, restart_en, stop_en, and related transaction outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises command-dependent acknowledge and hold qualification across transfer configurations and stored receive conditions."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP11",
    "name": "arbitration_loss_recovery",
    "action": "Assert arb_lost during addressed-byte, transmit-byte, or receive-byte processing while completion, NACK, hold, and stop inputs also request progress.",
    "variation": "Active operation: address, transmit, receive; competing completion inputs: asserted",
    "observation": "Observe mstfsm_idle_state, stop_en, start_en, restart_en, mst_tx_en, mst_rx_en, and queued-work routing outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises arbitration-loss priority over competing operation completions and recovery toward pre-idle behavior without normal transaction completion."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP12",
    "name": "flush_and_disable_recovery",
    "action": "Assert flush_txfifo after arbitration loss or stop completion, vary ctrl_en and FIFO status, then release flush and create a fresh enable edge.",
    "variation": "Flush: asserted/deasserted; enable: asserted/deasserted; FIFO: queued/empty",
    "observation": "Observe mstfsm_idle_state, start_en, stop_en, load_tx_shifter, pop_tx_fifo_state, and transaction control outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises flush suppression of queued work, disable-dependent return to idle, and requirement for a fresh enable edge before relaunch."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP13",
    "name": "stop_completion_routing",
    "action": "Complete a requested stop with txfifo_empty_nodly indicating queued or empty work, then observe immediate post-stop routing and subsequent admission.",
    "variation": "Post-stop FIFO status: queued/empty; flush: clear/asserted",
    "observation": "Observe stop_en, gen_stop_state, mstfsm_idle_state, start_en, load_tx_shifter, and pop_tx_fifo_state.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises stop completion routing to a queued follow-on start or idle recovery, including flush blocking after stop."
  }
]

[
  {
    "id": "TP01",
    "name": "active_low_reset",
    "action": "Prepare idle or each transfer interruption phase, assert rst_n low, then release it while varying the prepared phase.",
    "variation": "phases: idle, clock-load, low, high, completion, hold, acknowledge-low",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_scl_high_cnt_en, mst_tx_scl_low_cnt_en, mst_tx_chk_ack, mst_tx_shift_done, mst_tx_scl_out, mst_tx_sda_out, load_mst_tx_scl_high_cnt, load_mst_tx_scl_low_cnt, tx_shifter, mst_txdata_phase.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise active-low reset initialization and recovery from each transfer phase, including restoration of port outputs and stored transmit data."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP02",
    "name": "load_transmit_word",
    "action": "Pulse load_tx_shifter while applying successive tx_fifo_data_in words, then change the input after loading and retain the selected word.",
    "variation": "tx_fifo_data_in: 10'h000, 10'h3ff, 10'h1a5, 10'h25a; consecutive loads and post-load changes",
    "observation": "Observe tx_shifter and all transfer-control, clock, data, acknowledge, completion, and phase outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise transmit-word loading, replacement by later loads, and isolation of tx_shifter from subsequent input changes."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP03",
    "name": "data_byte_serialization",
    "action": "Load a word, select data-byte transmission with tx_byte_state, assert mst_tx_en, and provide completed low and high timing indications through nine periods.",
    "variation": "byte patterns: 8'h00, 8'hff, 8'ha5, 8'h5a; upper tx_fifo_data_in bits varied",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_scl_out, mst_tx_sda_out, mst_tx_chk_ack, mst_txdata_phase, mst_tx_shift_done, mst_tx_scl_high_cnt_en, mst_tx_scl_low_cnt_en, load_mst_tx_scl_high_cnt, load_mst_tx_scl_low_cnt, and tx_shifter.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise most-significant-first data-byte serialization, upper-bit independence, acknowledge slot handling, and byte completion signaling."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP04",
    "name": "seven_bit_address_serialization",
    "action": "Load a word, select 7-bit address transmission with gen_7bit_addr_state, assert mst_tx_en, and provide completed low and high timing indications.",
    "variation": "address patterns: 8'h00, 8'hff, 8'ha5, 8'h5a; upper tx_fifo_data_in bits varied",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_scl_out, mst_tx_sda_out, mst_tx_chk_ack, mst_txdata_phase, mst_tx_shift_done, mst_tx_scl_high_cnt_en, mst_tx_scl_low_cnt_en, load_mst_tx_scl_high_cnt, load_mst_tx_scl_low_cnt, and tx_shifter.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise address-mode serialization from the loaded word while retaining acknowledge-slot and completion behavior."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP05",
    "name": "clock_phase_timing",
    "action": "Start enabled transmission and alternate low-clock completion, high-clock completion, direct-high entry, and delayed high completion across nine periods.",
    "variation": "timing paths: low phase first, direct high phase, falling scl_int during high phase",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_scl_out, mst_tx_sda_out, mst_tx_scl_high_cnt_en, mst_tx_scl_low_cnt_en, load_mst_tx_scl_high_cnt, load_mst_tx_scl_low_cnt, mst_tx_chk_ack, and mst_tx_shift_done.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise low and high clock timing paths, including externally held-low clock behavior before high-phase progress."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP06",
    "name": "acknowledge_and_completion",
    "action": "Run complete nine-period transmissions with scl_int high and low, allowing the final data period to enter the acknowledge slot and complete the byte.",
    "variation": "ack timing: scl_int high; scl_int forced low during final high phase",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_sda_out, mst_tx_scl_out, mst_tx_chk_ack, mst_tx_shift_done, mst_txdata_phase, mst_tx_scl_high_cnt_en, mst_tx_scl_low_cnt_en, load_mst_tx_scl_high_cnt, and load_mst_tx_scl_low_cnt.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise released data during the acknowledge slot, acknowledge indication, and the single completion pulse after all nine periods."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP07",
    "name": "completion_hold",
    "action": "Complete a transmission with mstfsm_emptyfifo_hold_en asserted, then keep mst_tx_en active before clearing the hold condition and disabling transmission.",
    "variation": "hold control: disabled or asserted at completion",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_scl_out, mst_tx_sda_out, mst_tx_chk_ack, mst_tx_shift_done, mst_tx_scl_high_cnt_en, mst_tx_scl_low_cnt_en, load_mst_tx_scl_high_cnt, load_mst_tx_scl_low_cnt, and mst_txdata_phase.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise completed-transfer retention until continuation is permitted, including held clock and data outputs."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP08",
    "name": "enable_interruption_and_restart",
    "action": "Deassert mst_tx_en during each transfer phase, observe termination, then restart from idle using the retained transmit word.",
    "variation": "interruption phases: idle, clock-load, low, high, completion, hold, acknowledge-low",
    "observation": "Observe mst_tx_scl_out, mst_tx_sda_out, mst_tx_chk_ack, mst_tx_shift_done, mst_tx_scl_high_cnt_en, mst_tx_scl_low_cnt_en, load_mst_tx_scl_high_cnt, load_mst_tx_scl_low_cnt, tx_shifter, and mst_txdata_phase.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercise transfer cancellation from every phase and subsequent restart without reloading the retained transmit word."
  }
]

[
  {
    "id": "TP01",
    "name": "reset_and_idle_gating",
    "action": "Apply synchronous rst with all requests inactive, then release reset and vary OUT_req_rdy and request-valid inputs through idle and stalled conditions.",
    "variation": "OUT_req_rdy: 0/1; request-valid inputs: none/all asserted",
    "observation": "Observe ack_OUT_req, ack_ic_req, ack_dc_req, ack_mem_req, and select for no-grant behavior.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises reset to idle and output-readiness gating, showing that no client is acknowledged without a ready output or pending request."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP02",
    "name": "instruction_priority_and_ownership",
    "action": "With OUT_req_rdy asserted and all requests valid, grant the instruction cache, then alter valid requests and readiness while its control input remains non-terminal.",
    "variation": "Request-valid combinations and OUT_req_rdy: all valid, instruction plus memory, ready/stalled",
    "observation": "Observe ack_OUT_req, ack_ic_req, ack_dc_req, ack_mem_req, and select during instruction-cache ownership.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises absolute instruction-cache priority and retained ownership across changing requests and output stalls."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP03",
    "name": "client_transfer_completion",
    "action": "Present a sole data-cache or memory request with OUT_req_rdy asserted, continue with a non-terminal control value, then apply terminal control and remove the request.",
    "variation": "Client: data-cache/memory; control: non-terminal/terminal; request-valid: asserted/deasserted",
    "observation": "Observe all acknowledgement outputs and select during grant, continuation, terminal control, and release.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises client-specific ownership, continued acknowledgement, and release on terminal control for data-cache and memory transfers."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP04",
    "name": "data_memory_alternation",
    "action": "With OUT_req_rdy asserted and both data-cache and memory requests valid, observe the initial grant, continue the selected ownership, then alter control values and observe subsequent arbitration.",
    "variation": "Initial tie winner and subsequent terminal/non-terminal control values",
    "observation": "Observe all acknowledgement outputs and select across competing data-cache and memory grants.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises alternating priority between simultaneous data-cache and memory requests across arbitration rounds."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP05",
    "name": "priority_preference_preservation",
    "action": "Execute uncontested data-cache and instruction-cache grants, then present simultaneous data-cache and memory requests to exercise the retained tie preference.",
    "variation": "Preceding grant: data-cache/instruction-cache; final requests: data-cache plus memory",
    "observation": "Observe all acknowledgement outputs and select for the final competing grant.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises that uncontested and instruction-cache grants do not alter the alternating preference used for data-cache versus memory ties."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP06",
    "name": "stalled_terminal_ownership",
    "action": "Start a data-cache transfer, deassert OUT_req_rdy and the active request while asserting other requests with terminal control, then restore readiness to complete ownership.",
    "variation": "OUT_req_rdy: asserted/stalled; active request: asserted/deasserted; competing requests: inactive/active",
    "observation": "Observe all acknowledgement outputs and select while ownership is stalled and after readiness returns.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises ownership retention during output unavailability and release only when a terminal transfer can complete."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP07",
    "name": "reset_active_transfer",
    "action": "Begin a ready data-cache transfer, assert rst during the active transfer, and hold it through a rising clock before releasing reset.",
    "observation": "Observe all acknowledgement outputs and select before, during, and after synchronous reset.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises synchronous reset overriding an active transfer and returning arbitration to idle behavior."
  }
]

[
  {
    "id": "TP01",
    "name": "logical_left_shift",
    "action": "Apply i_function for logical shift left, i_shift_imm_zero low, and vary i_in, i_carry_in, and i_shift_amount across tested values.",
    "variation": "i_in: 0x00000000, 0xffffffff, 0xa5c396a5, 0x5a3c695a; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for each logical left shift.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises zero-filling left shifts and carry extraction across data patterns, incoming carries, and representative shift-distance encodings."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP02",
    "name": "logical_left_zero_encoding",
    "action": "Apply i_function for logical shift left with i_shift_imm_zero asserted, while varying i_in, i_carry_in, and i_shift_amount.",
    "variation": "i_in: four patterns; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for the immediate-zero left-shift case.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises the special no-shift encoding and its carry behavior independently of the supplied shift amount."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP03",
    "name": "logical_right_shift",
    "action": "Apply i_function for logical shift right, keep i_shift_imm_zero low, and vary i_in, i_carry_in, and i_shift_amount across tested values.",
    "variation": "i_in: four patterns; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for each logical right shift.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises zero-filling right shifts and shifted-out carry selection across varied data and shift-distance encodings."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP04",
    "name": "logical_right_zero_encoding",
    "action": "Apply i_function for logical shift right with i_shift_imm_zero asserted, while varying i_in, i_carry_in, and i_shift_amount.",
    "variation": "i_in: four patterns; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for the immediate-zero logical right-shift case.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises the special full-width logical right shift, including sign-bit carry behavior, independent of the supplied amount."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP05",
    "name": "arithmetic_right_shift",
    "action": "Apply i_function for arithmetic shift right, keep i_shift_imm_zero low, and vary i_in, i_carry_in, and i_shift_amount across tested values.",
    "variation": "i_in: four patterns; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for each arithmetic right shift.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises sign-preserving right shifts and shifted-out carry selection using positive, negative, and patterned input data."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP06",
    "name": "arithmetic_right_zero_encoding",
    "action": "Apply i_function for arithmetic shift right with i_shift_imm_zero asserted, while varying i_in, i_carry_in, and i_shift_amount.",
    "variation": "i_in: four patterns; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for the immediate-zero arithmetic right-shift case.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises the special full-width arithmetic shift, exposing sign replication and carry behavior for both input signs."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP07",
    "name": "rotate_right",
    "action": "Apply i_function for rotate right, keep i_shift_imm_zero low, and vary i_in, i_carry_in, and i_shift_amount across tested values.",
    "variation": "i_in: four patterns; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for each rotate-right operation.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises right rotation with vacated high bits refilled from shifted-out input bits across varied patterns and distances."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP08",
    "name": "rotate_through_carry",
    "action": "Apply i_function for rotate right with i_shift_imm_zero asserted, while varying i_in and i_carry_in across tested values.",
    "variation": "i_in: four patterns; carry: 0/1; amount: 0-7, 32-35, 252-255",
    "observation": "Observe o_out and o_carry_out for the rotate-right-through-carry case.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises the special rotate-through-carry encoding, including incoming-carry insertion and outgoing-bit carry behavior."
  }
]

[
  {
    "id": "TP01",
    "name": "chip_status_passthrough",
    "action": "Apply uniform all-zero and all-one chip-level status patterns, then sweep a walking one across the status inputs while varying fetch and ECC fetch-error.",
    "variation": "Uniform patterns {0, all-1}; walking-one positions across 9xMEM_IF_CS_WIDTH bits; fetch/ECC values vary with position.",
    "observation": "Observe all out_cs_all_banks_closed, out_cs_can_precharge_all, out_cs_can_refresh, out_cs_can_self_refresh, out_cs_can_power_down, out_cs_can_exit_power_saving_mode, out_cs_zq_cal_req, out_cs_power_down_req, and out_cs_refresh_req outputs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises chip-level status pass-through across uniform and one-hot patterns, including active request controls, to expose bit mapping or control-dependent changes."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP02",
    "name": "command_window_shift",
    "action": "Apply uniform zero, uniform one, and walking-one command-status patterns with matching validity patterns; pulse fetch, then observe the command window during and after advancement.",
    "variation": "Command positions 0 through CTL_LOOK_AHEAD_DEPTH; cmd_is_valid positions 0 through CTL_CMD_QUEUE_DEPTH.",
    "observation": "Observe out_cmd_bank_is_open, out_cmd_row_is_open, out_cmd_can_write, out_cmd_can_read, out_cmd_can_activate, out_cmd_can_precharge, and out_cmd_info_valid.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises direct forwarding and fetch-driven command-window advancement across distinct bit positions, including validity inputs beyond the look-ahead range."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP03",
    "name": "validity_bit_mapping",
    "action": "Set each cmd_is_valid bit individually, pulse fetch, and observe the resulting command validity outputs as the command window advances.",
    "variation": "One-hot cmd_is_valid positions 0 through CTL_CMD_QUEUE_DEPTH.",
    "observation": "Observe out_cmd_info_valid across all look-ahead positions before and after the fetch sequence.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises per-position validity propagation and fetch exposure, including queue-validity positions not used by the look-ahead window."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP04",
    "name": "fetch_ecc_validity_sequences",
    "action": "Apply every three-cycle fetch and ECC fetch-error combination, then apply two idle cycles to observe the resulting validity behavior.",
    "variation": "All 64 three-cycle sequences over fetch/ECC pairs {00, 01, 10, 11}.",
    "observation": "Observe out_cmd_info_valid across the look-ahead positions during stimulus and the two following idle cycles.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises overlapping and consecutive fetch and ECC fetch-error events, including their delayed effects on current command validity."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP05",
    "name": "reset_validity_and_history",
    "action": "After fetch-driven advancement, apply each fetch/ECC combination and assert active-low reset; release reset and apply two idle cycles.",
    "variation": "Fetch/ECC combinations {00, 01, 10, 11}.",
    "observation": "Observe out_cmd_info_valid and all command-status outputs through reset assertion, release, and subsequent idle cycles.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises asynchronous reset after validity and event history have been established, exposing whether prior event effects persist after reset."
  }
]

[
  {
    "id": "TP01",
    "name": "synchronous_reset_load",
    "action": "Assert RST across rising clock edges with B, R, X, Y, and player applied, then release reset and allow processing to continue.",
    "variation": "player: 0,1; X,Y: varied; board maps: empty, occupied, and unrelated squares",
    "observation": "Observe MB and MR after reset assertion, while held, and during subsequent processing.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises synchronous reset loading of board maps and coordinates, including moving-colour selection and reset-held behavior."
  },
  {
    "id": "TP02",
    "name": "rightward_scan_outcomes",
    "action": "Load a placement and row patterns, then release RST to exercise rightward scans through bounded opponent runs, gaps, brackets, and the row edge.",
    "variation": "current/opponent row patterns: empty, single, consecutive, gap, bracketed, unbracketed, edge; X,Y: varied",
    "observation": "Observe MB and MR for placement eligibility, opponent removal, moving-disc insertion, and unchanged unbracketed runs.",
    "branch_intent": "Exercises rightward termination and reversal behavior for bracketed and unbracketed opponent sequences."
  },
  {
